# Taiwan Mandarin pronunciation audio

Source and attribution: 中華民國教育部（Ministry of Education, R.O.C.）,《國語辭典簡編本》.
Official website: https://dict.concised.moe.edu.tw/
Official public licensing / downloads: https://language.moe.gov.tw/001/Upload/Files/site_content/M0001/respub/dict_concised_download.html

The official download page makes the dictionary dataset (including single-word audio) available under Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivs 3.0 Taiwan (姓名標示－禁止改作 3.0 臺灣). Preserve attribution, the original recording, and the accompanying original use instructions in LICENSE-MOE.pdf. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/3.0/tw/

MP3 files in this directory are whole original official single-word recordings. They have not been spliced, trimmed, speed-shifted, or otherwise altered. Filenames are official dictionary IDs. These are character/word pronunciations, not COCT sentence recordings.

Metadata matching uses exact headword + normalized complete Zhuyin from the official 2026-09-29 dictionary text export. A website entry ID differs from the dictionary's 字詞號. See ../audio-manifest.json for successfully available files and ../../audio-sources.json for validation candidates. Candidates must pass HTTP status, Content-Type and actual MPEG audio validation before being marked downloaded; an inferred path alone is not proof a file exists.

Acquired through Chrome on 2026-11-04: 2550.mp3 (kān) and 2562.mp3 (kàn), each displayed playable official audio and completed downloads. Other audio assets, if present, are acquired by the build from the same official host and recorded in the manifest after validation.

A final human listening review is still appropriate before classroom release. In particular, earlier third-party audio mappings label 看見 with neutral-tone 見, whereas the current official dictionary export has kàn jiàn. Do not silently replace current metadata with an older mirror or ambiguous isolated-character TTS.
